title: AI-augmented diagnostic radiology
about: Base case. Developed in 25 months of cognitive ethnography in a U.S. academic radiology department using several FDA-cleared AI tools.

L.title: Left monitor
L.definition: Left monitor: PACS worklist (with AI result column), priors, EHR, chat.

CL.title: Centre, left pane
CL.definition: Centre monitor, left pane (C1): main image.

CR.title: Centre, right pane
CR.definition: Centre monitor, right pane (C2): other views, priors, comparisons.

PACS.definition: Picture archiving and communication system (worklist and viewer).

Vendor AI.definition: Commercial AI platform from an external vendor (triage, overlays, second opinion).

In-house AI.definition: AI models developed inside the department or health system.

Email.definition: Institutional email (e.g., alerts from the department).

Chat.definition: Messaging to reach or answer colleagues (in the PACS or the EHR).

Web search.definition: General web search, mostly to look up reference images.

General-purpose AI.definition: ChatGPT, Grok or similar, mostly to look up reference images.

Rad Ops.definition: Radiology operations staff who contact the referring clinician.

Worklist.definition: Open or scan the PACS worklist and choose the next study.

Check AI result column.definition: Read the AI result column in the worklist (e.g. 'No finding', 'ETT 3.4') before or instead of opening the study.

AI triage.definition: An AI model reorders or flags studies in the worklist before the read.

Read main image.definition: The reader's own read of the primary images: scrolling, zooming, windowing.

AI overlay.definition: An AI marking shown on or beside the image in the viewer (heatmap, box, ping).

Cross-check views.definition: Compare the primary view with other views, series or the AI output in the second pane.

Re-examine image.definition: Return to the image specifically to test a claim that has been questioned.

Search priors.definition: Find and open earlier studies of the same patient.

Compare prior volumes.definition: Measure a finding against priors (size, volume, growth).

Review patient history.definition: Read history, notes, labs or status in the EHR.

Look up reference images.definition: Search outside the record (web search or a general-purpose AI) for what a finding typically looks like.

Message colleague.definition: Ask or answer a colleague through chat (PACS or EHR).

Decode AI flag.definition: Work out what an AI flag refers to when its what, where or why is not shown.

Reconstruct AI claim.definition: Search the image for the basis of an AI claim that gives no explanation.

AI second opinion.definition: An AI read offered for comparison after the reader's own read.

Deprioritise case.definition: Set a flagged case aside and read another first.

Dictate report.definition: Dictate findings and impression, often by choosing template options.

Flag critical result.definition: Insert the critical-result flag in the report macro so Rad Ops is alerted.

Flag in RIS.definition: Mark the case in the radiology information system for follow-up.

Sign off report.definition: Sign the report. The point where a claim reaches closure.

Notify clinician via Rad Ops.definition: Rad Ops staff contact the referring clinician about a flagged result.

Model update drift.definition: Institutional event: a model's behaviour changes after an update.

Non-engagement alert.definition: Institutional event: the department tracks whether readers looked at the AI output.

ai_models.triage: Vendor triage model shown in the worklist (square Ai in the notebook)
ai_models.widget: Vendor model shown as a widget in the viewer (rounded Ai in the notebook)
ai_models.other: Any other model; name it in detail

independent_checks: Priors, other views or series, measurements against priors, patient history, a colleague, a reference image.
